//: The browser half of the package: the `./webgl-shader` and `./ui` entries. It is a separate project so the DOM lib and the JSX factory they need stay off `src/index.ts`, which is what apps/api compiles - a DOM type that reached the contracts would type-check here and fail in node. The modules `./ui` imports from `src` are emitted by both projects; the JS is identical either way, since `lib` decides what type-checks and never what is written.
